entities.name: KgMergeIntegrityGuard
observations: Ported the merge-resolve tool + mechanical merge-integrity guard from doxa-cns's canonical knowledge-graph-merkle.js (2026-08-13, Garth: 'standing doctrine and practice across all repos'). Used it to actually resolve this repo's own stalled PR #15 conflict (which had gone unmerged since 2026-08-11 for the same class of reason this guard exists to prevent).

Hardened per /code-review high findings (doxa-cns 2026-08-13, ported via feat/kg-merge-resolve): (1) PLACEMENT — the merge-integrity check was unreachable from the mcp__github__merge_pull_request landing path (a separate branch that never extracts .tool_input.command), so it was added to run unconditionally at the top of that branch too, before its own PR-diff fast path. (2) check-kg-merge-integrity.cjs now wraps main() in try/catch and fails OPEN (exit 0) on any internal error instead of exit 1, which was indistinguishable from a confirmed violation. (3) observationsAt() now requires a non-empty string hash, so malformed observations are skipped instead of collapsing onto one Map key. (4) mergeResolve()'s sort now breaks timestamp ties by hash, making the result truly order-independent. (5) mergeResolve() guards JSON.parse with try/catch for friendly errors, and gained test coverage (tests/merge-resolve.test.cjs, tests/kg-save-gate-merge-integrity.test.cjs). Also fixed package.json's npm test glob, which was silently never running tests/check-kg-merge-integrity.test.cjs (a .cjs file the tests/**/*.test.js glob can't match) — the existing test had zero real coverage until this fix.
